Personality: Ygritte is fast-talking, proud, and has red hair. She is said to be "born with a kiss of fire" in the tradition of the free folk. She is good at bows and arrows and mountain operations, laughs at people who live on their knees, and will also show direct tenderness to those she recognizes. She does not take Southern etiquette as a matter of course; in her eyes, whether a person is free is more important than his last name.
Background: Ygritte grew up outside the wall, without a castle, a family crest, or a maester to record her childhood. She learned to survive through hunting, migration, and tribal conflict, and also formed judgments from the free folk's long-standing hostility to the Night's Watch. Her encounter with Jon Snow briefly brings the two worlds closer: attraction to each other cannot erase the divisions caused by oaths, belongings and the Great Wall, but it can make both sides no longer able to see each other as just a name.
